senses.gloss:
नख् नख् or नङ्ख्, cl. 4. and 1. P.
नख्यति, नखति and नङ्खति, &c.,
Ved. to move, go.

नख नख, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be fr. rt.
1. नह्, perhaps fr. नघ् for rt. अङ्घ् = अङ्क्, to
move in a curve; in Pāṇ. VI. 3, 75, derived fr. न +
ख), a nail of a finger or of a toe, a claw, talon, the
spur of a cock; an expression for the number twenty;
(अस्), m. a part, portion; (अम्, ई), n. f. a particular
perfume, a dried substance of a brown colour and of
the shape of a nail, apparently a dried shell-fish (=
शुक्ति) used as a perfume, see धूप्य; (ई), f. a vege-
table perfume different from the above though known
by the same name, नखी; [cf. Lith. naga-s,
‘nail;’ Slav. nogŭ-tĭ = Russ. nogotĭ; Gr. ἔ-νυξ;
Lat. unguis, ungula; Old Germ. nagal; Angl.
Sax. naegel; Hib. ionga, perhaps for nionga.]
—नख-कुट्ट, अस्, m. ‘a nail-cutter,’ a barber.
—नख-खादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, ‘eating the nails,’
biting the nails.
—नख-गुच्छ-फला, f. = नख-
निष्पाव.
—नख-छेद, अस्, m. nail-paring, nail-
cutting.
—नख-जाह, अम्, n. the root of a nail.
—नख-दारण, अस्, m. ‘tearing with the nails,’
a falcon, a hawk.
—नख-निकृन्तन, अस् or अम्,
[]
m. or n. (?), a pair of nail-scissors.
—नख-निष्-
पाव, अस्, m. or नख-निष्पाविका or नख-
निष्पावी, f. a kind of pulse.
—नख-पद, अम्,
n. the mark of a finger-nail, a scratch.
—नख-
पर्णी, f. a species of plant (= वृश्चिका).
—नख-
पुञ्ज-फला, f. = नख-निष्पाव.
—नख-
पुष्पी, f. a species of grass (= पृक्का).
—नख-
पूर्विका or नख-फलिनी, f. = नख-निष्पाव.
—नख-भिन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘nail-divided,’ scratched
or torn off with a nail.
—नख-मुच, अस्, m. ‘nail-
looser,’ a bow.
—नखम्-पच, अस्, आ, अम्, nail-
scalding, nail-scorching.
—नख-रजनी, f. a species
of plant and its fruit.
—नख-रञ्जनी, f. a nail-
parer.
—नख-लेखक, अस्, m. a nail-painter.
—नख-लेखा, f. a scratch; nail-painting.
—न-
ख-विलेख, अस्, m. a scratch; nail-painting (?).
—नख-विष, अस्, आ, अम्, having venom in the
nails or claws.
—नख-विष्किर, अस्, आ, अम्, tearing
or rending with the claws; (अस्), m. a bird of prey.
—नख-वृक्ष, अस्, m. a species of plant (=
नील-वृक्ष).
—नख-व्रण, अम्, n. ‘nail-wound,’
a scratch.
—नख-शङ्ख, अस्, m. a small shell.
—नखांशु (˚ख-अं˚), उस्, m. elegance or bright-
ness of the finger-nails.
—नखाङ्क (˚ख-अङ्˚),
अम्, n. ‘nail-mark,’ a scratch; a sort of perfume (=
व्याघ्र-नखी).
—नखाङ्ग (˚ख-अङ्˚), अम्, n.
a kind of perfume (= नली).
—नखा-नखि, ind.
nail against nail, (a fight with) mutual scratching,
scratching one another.
—नखायुध (˚ख-आय्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, ‘claw-armed,’ using the nails or claws as
weapons; (अस्), m. an animal which uses its claws
as weapons, any beast or bird having talons; a tiger;
a lion; a cock; a monkey, &c.
—नखायुध-त्व,
अम्, n. the state of being claw-armed or of using claws
as weapons.
—नखारि (˚ख-अरि), इस्, m., N. of
one of the attendants of Śiva.
—नखालि, इस्, m. or
नखालिका (˚ख-आल्˚), f. a small shell; [cf. नख-
शङ्ख.]
—नखाशिन् (˚ख-आश्˚), ई, m. ‘eating
with claws,’ an owl (as using its claws in feeding).
नखक, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga-rāja.

नखर, अस्, आ, अम्, shaped like a claw, any
pointed and curved instrument (as a knife, sword,
&c.); (अस्, आ, अम्), m. f. n. a finger-nail, claw; (ई),
f. a kind of perfume (= नखी, = क्षुद्र-नखी).
—नखरायुध (˚र-आय्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘claw-
armed,’ using claws as weapons; (अस्), m. a lion,
tiger, any beast of prey; a cock.
—नखराह्व
(˚र-अह्˚), अस्, m. fragrant oleander (= कर-
वीर).
नखालु, उस्, m. = नख-वृक्ष, q. v.

नखिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having nails, armed with claws
or talons, clawed; thorny, prickly; (ई), m. an
animal or a beast with claws, especially the lion.
